transfer.reviewed_identity: This is the retained Barcelona–Bayern clip from 6 May 2015. Barcelona's number 10 is Lionel Messi, as identified in the project's previous manual footage review. Identity is supplied, not inferred anew.

research.text: Messi was poised for his 100th appearance in UEFA competition.
Barcelona entered the match after scoring 14 goals in their last two games and keeping five consecutive clean sheets.
Bayern coach Josep Guardiola was returning to Barcelona for the first time with Bayern, after four years coaching Barcelona.
